tasks.title: What Klacksy does for you
tasks.0.title: Plan next week?
tasks.0.text: One sentence to Klacksy starts the planning. Klacks calculates – and you say yes.
tasks.1.title: What's in the Error List?
tasks.1.text: Klacks checks your rules. The Error List shows violations – Klacksy explains them.
tasks.2.title: Someone can't make it?
tasks.2.text: Klacksy shows suitable people and explains why – you choose.
human.title: Klacksy doesn't replace anyone in planning – Klacksy takes the grunt work off your hands.
human.text: You say in one sentence what you need. Klacksy shows you a preview and only does it once you say yes. Klacks calculates the plan according to your rules. What only you know – who can be reached at night, who can't manage another shift right now – isn't in any system. That's why you decide.
talk.title: How to talk to Klacksy
talk.text: One click on Klacksy at the top right – and off you go.
talk.bubble.1: Anna is ill tomorrow. Who can step in?
talk.bubble.2: Why is Beat in the Error List?
ai.title: Built for the age of AI
ai.text: Klacks gives Klacksy its capabilities. You choose the AI model behind it: from a provider of your choice or on your own server. Today's best model, tomorrow the next – you're not tied to anyone.
data.title: Your data
data.text: Your data stays with you – not with us and not in any Klacks cloud. You decide which outside services Klacks uses – such as the AI model or the map service.
cost.title: What does it cost?
cost.item.0: No licence fees, no subscription – Klacks is open source.
cost.item.1: All you need is your own computer or server and the AI model of your choice.
cost.item.2: And, if you like, an IT service provider who looks after Klacks for you.
audience.title: Who is it for?
audience.more: … and anyone who puts together rotas

demoModal.title: Heads up: the Playground is public
demoModal.body: The Playground is only for trying things out and playing around — it is not a production installation. All data is periodically reset. The AI assistant Klacksy uses external AI providers here — do not enter real personal data. In your own installation you choose the AI model yourself, including a local one.
demoModal.languageNote: The default language is German. You can switch the language in the app under Profile.
demoData.note: Note on the sample data: All names, places (for example Winterthur), addresses and figures in these recordings are fictitious demo data with a Swiss background, written in Latin script. They only illustrate the product – you do not need to know or be able to read them. In your own installation you enter your own data, and the interface is multilingual.
